correctedCritiques.pro-objective-logic-logos: Strongest feature: The reply engages projection and divine-grounding objections by presenting logic as reality’s objective structure and explaining how interdependent moments support the Christian Logos framework. Principal limitation: Ground, meta-ground, Logos, and Trinity alternate between explanatory and identificatory functions, while Christian exclusivity restates the disputed conclusion without deriving mentality, personhood, or triune identity from logical interdependence. Live burden: The affirmative must demonstrate why objective validity requires mentality, why interdependence establishes personal relations, and why those relations uniquely identify Christianity instead of nonmental logical realism or metaphysical foundation. Locked score: The mixed band recognizes direct responsiveness, central relevance, and a recoverable metaphysical proposal, while retaining deductions for overstated exclusivity, unstable terminology, inadequate independent warrant, and incomplete ontological mapping.
correctedCritiques.con-logic-trinity-mapping-gap: Strongest feature: The reply isolates the difference between triadic resemblance and ontological identity, explaining why assigning logical categories to divine persons cannot demonstrate the Christian Trinity. Principal limitation: Its description of the mapping is unnecessary, and the response does not examine the explanation of how relations among logical moments could generate mentality, personal distinction, or numerical plurality. Live burden: The skeptical side must preserve the metaphor-versus-identity distinction while addressing any affirmative derivation of mentality, personhood, numerical distinction, and Christian correspondence rather than dismissing an ontological interpretation. Locked score: The very strong band reflects decisive target contact, terminological stability, careful qualification, logical coherence, and burden relevance, with modest reservation for limited constructive analysis of the affirmative’s strongest interpretation.
